_help.how: Add one entry per property to 'listings', separated by commas. Copy the blank entry at the bottom. Entries with "_example": true are ignored.

required.name: Short name, e.g. '4 bed terrace, Fishers Lane'
required.price: Rent per month in pounds, e.g. 3800

optional (leave out, or set to null, if.status: One of: Not contacted, Enquired, Viewing booked, Viewed, Offer made, Secured, Denied, Not for us, No longer available. Blank = Not contacted
optional (leave out, or set to null, if.hmo_licensed: true, false, or null if you don't know
optional (leave out, or set to null, if.status_date: When the status last changed, e.g. '2026-10-28'
optional (leave out, or set to null, if.agent: Agent or landlord name / phone / email
optional (leave out, or set to null, if.source: Where you found it, e.g. Rightmove
optional (leave out, or set to null, if.lat: Latitude, only if the postcode puts the pin in the wrong place
